Hi there!
I am Raji (pronounced “RAH-jee”).

I work at the intersection of sustainability science and data analytics
I apply Life Cycle Assessment and Bio-Systems Modeling to sustainability questions in supply chain logistics, most recently at the University of Florida. I’m also the first in my family to earn a college degree, a fact that still shapes how I approach research: I tend to ask why a system works the way it does before I ask how to optimize it.

title: Rajeshwari Periyaswamy
text:
Professional Summary
Results-driven Data Analyst with 2+ years of industry experience in BI and data engineering at Infosys, and 2 years of advanced research applying data science to real-world sustainability problems at the University of Florida (CGPA 4.0/4.0). Skilled in end-to-end analytics from SQL-based data pipelines and Python automation to interactive dashboards (Power BI, Tableau, R Shiny) and statistical modeling. Combines strong technical depth with domain expertise in supply chain, environmental data, and Life Cycle Assessment (LCA).

title: Rajeshwari Periyaswamy
text:
Professional Experience

Graduate Research Analyst (Data & Sustainability)
University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA | Aug 2024 – May 2026

Led a comparative Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) study on fresh produce secondary transport packaging, modelling environmental data across the entire US–EU supply chain using SimaPro and OpenLCA, producing actionable insights on carbon footprint and resource use
Built an interactive R Shiny dashboard with Plotly visualizations for real-time LCA scenario comparison, including dynamic breakeven analysis and automated Quarto HTML report generation for users
Developed a dynamic Power BI dashboard to display and communicate LCA results to non-technical stakeholders
Applied QMRA statistical frameworks (R: biogrowth, mc2d) to model microbial contamination risk in fresh produce, performing EDA, normality testing, and distribution fitting on experimental datasets
Completed R Data Wrangling & EDA and R Data Analysis certifications (UF IT Training, Summer 2026), covering data transformation, outlier detection, and advanced ggplot2 visualizations



Postgraduate Research Assistant
IIT Kharagpur, India | Jul 2017 – May 2019

Conducted molecular and biochemical analyses, applying data interpretation skills to enzyme kinetics datasets – cloned and characterized a β-Lactamase gene using quantitative assay data
Performed bioinformatics analyses (NCBI BLAST, CLUSTAL W) on protein sequence datasets, applying computational tools to draw comparative conclusions across species



Systems Engineer – Business Intelligence & Data Analytics
Infosys Limited, Chennai, India | Sep 2015 – May 2017

Developed Python and MySQL based data automation systems for a multinational telecommunications client, reducing manual data processing efforts by streamlining batch jobs and ETL workflows
Designed and maintained relational database models supporting BI reporting needs; worked with Informatica for data integration across source systems
Built Cognos and Tableau dashboards to present KPIs and operational metrics to client stakeholders, enabling faster decision-making
Collaborated in Agile delivery teams, translating business requirements into technical data solutions

title: Musings
text:
So Be Kind
Some stop wearing their favorite clothes.
Some stop clicking pictures.
Some who once loved to travel, lock themselves in a dark room.
Some who once made everyone feel alive, now stay quiet.
Some who only wanted to be loved end up living in complete solitude.
Everyone commits suicide in a different way.
The weaker ones may die once, but some die more than once every minute.
So be kind !
— words borrowed and reshaped
